user_reviews:
[{"Name":"Sarthak Singh","ProfilePicture":"https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocKGet9IEycLzuhw5tFHOJ9C8Nc6a8hHye3Z9v6naUqqxMFQGA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100","Rating":1,"Description":"So here will be an honest review, i stayed for a whole year, these are some of the things that you should know before taking this pg,
I WOULD STRONGLY SUGGEST YOU TO READ THE WHOLE REVIEW SO THAT YOU DONT REGRET LATER.
you may even think that this guy is telling too much, but it is the truth.

1. FOOD - THE MOST IMPORTANT PART
quality of food will be firstly decent but after 2 months it gradually decreases, they give you a scheduled menu

- stuff like paneer will only be on weekends as most of the people who stay near go home on weekends so less than 30 percent of people are in the pg,
asked the owner about this after 2 months, he said that they do this to reduce costs

-  i dont wanna brag much about the food but they do this stuff intentionally

-from adding too many spices so that students can eat less, to mixing a glass of water in a spoon of curd to make it a raita.

2. THE VOTING SYSTEM FOR FOOD -
this is the thing that you'll observe only in this pg, not anywhere else, most students get tired of complaining about it to the manager, but he does nothing about it.

- it is that you have to vote hours before a meal if you want to eat it or not, if you forget to vote due to any reason, they deny you the food like you have not paid for it.

- if dinner is around 8pm, you have to vote before 5, then only your portion of dinner will be cooked,

-  they don't cook a bit extra, not even an egg extra for someone who forgot to vote.

-  they say that they do this to save food and prevent wastage, but it leads often to people fighting with the staff to give them food, while the staff says " 9 bje ke baad aana, agar khaana bachega to mil jayega".

3. CLEANING -
earlier they had a staff who cleaned the rooms whenever the students called but later they hired a maid who would come from 12 to 4, the exact time where everyone is in college, so they have to clean less rooms from inside

- they say that you can give us your key, but for that you have to trust the maid, which obv not everyone can do it

4. WHEN YOU GO TO TAKE THE PG

-  the manager tells that breakfast time will be 2 hrs, from 8 to 10, so that you are amazed and see the advantage to take the pg
he literally said " BAKI PG ME 1 HR HEE HOTA HAI, IDHAR 2 HR HOTA HAI BREAKFAST, AUR KAHI NE HOTA AISE"

-  the reality is that timings are 8-9, and if you go at 8:45, the food is already finished cos they bring less quantity, and later say " BETA AAP LATE AAYE, 8 BJE AATE "

5. WATER SUPPLY GOES DOWN - THAT TROUBLED MANY THE MOST
once every week, even the pattern was observed, every friday, or sometimes wed too, water would not flow from anywhere, even the bathroom and kitchen, also the water filter,
then you have to call the manager, then it comes again after 15min, they dont work on why water supply disrupts every week

6. THE ENTRY GATE

-  to enter the pg you have to write a code which you are given

-  but after 2-3 months, you are given a card and the manager says that " code kaam nahi kar raha, card se hee khulega machine kharab hai "

-  and if you lose that card, you have to pay a fine or call anyone to open door from inside,

- in reality the code still works and if you say
" bhaiya code bata do "
then he fights with you and says rudely
" AAPKO CARD ACCESS DIA HUA HAI, CODE ACCESS HUMARA HAI" , THIS IS AFTER HE SAID THAT CODE MACHINE IS NOT WORKING

6. lastly lets talk about the positives for this pg
